QF.id: Cat III AIF Overview and Growth_29

question.text: Category III AIFs are 'more suited' to investors who:

answer.text: Have 2+ years investment horizon, higher risk tolerance, and Rs. 1+ crore investable surplus

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 2.4.2 and 3.3, Cat III AIFs suit investors with multi-year horizon, high risk tolerance, and Rs. 1+ crore investable. The Trap: Opposite profiles don't fit Cat III. Cross-Exam Context: Suitability assessment. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Use a scorecard to assess suitability before recommending Cat III.
